title: Mock scenario
description: Slice 34: declarative mock-engine scenarios. Schema-validated alternative to imperative legacy_scenarios.rs. Runtime-dispatched scenarios (runtime_dispatch=true) drive the timeline via tools/mock-engine/src/scenarios.rs and short-circuit before legacy fallback.

scenario.description: Stable scenario ID; matches the Rust runtime registry key.

status.description: How this scenario relates to canonical event catalog. legacy_mock_only requires a replacement.

replacement.description: Required when status=legacy_mock_only; ID of the canonical scenario or event that replaces this one.

runtime_dispatch.description: When true, scenarios.rs short-circuits this command and drives the timeline + final_response. When false/absent, legacy_scenarios.rs still owns the handler.

state_seeds.description: Per-scenario template variables. Values may be a literal string (used verbatim) or a generator name: 'next_shell_id', 'next_msg_id', 'next_tool_call_id', 'next_job_id', 'session_id'. Each generator is invoked once per dispatch.

payload.description: Notification params. String values containing ${var} are substituted from state_seeds at dispatch time.

final_response.description: JSON-RPC response result emitted after the timeline. String values support ${var} substitution. Omit for notification-only scenarios.
